body:
Merged `origin/main` (e0cb0049, v0.18.0) into the branch: head is now `ef65c32e`. No conflict; `Cargo.lock` merged by itself and passes `--locked`.

Lock against main, package by package: registry `solidcore` 1.0.1 replaced by the git one, five `solidcore-*` git packages added (`-convert`, `-ops`, `-record`, `-step`, `-tess`), and `camcraft-kernel`'s own dependency list. Nothing else differs; `flecs_ecs`, `flecs_ecs_sys` and the `ruststep` source are main's.

On the merged tree: kernel release suites 25 passed / 0 failed / 2 ignored; the 2 heavy-lane tests passed with `--ignored`; clippy `-D warnings` on the kernel crate clean; wasm32 check of the kernel crate ok; `cargo check -p camcraft-app` ok. App's and ui's suites were not re-run on this head.

Correction: the pin brings 6 git packages (552 -> 557 in the lock), not 5 (556) as the first commit message, the PR body and the issue comment said - that count was taken before the mesh bench's dev-dependency was added. The decision file and this PR's body are corrected; the first commit's message stays as it is (no rewrite).

Still a draft. `docs/decisions/916-solidcore-step-bench.md` stays in `docs/decisions/`.

**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** ~$1.07 priced (227k tokens priced; the worker run is not priced)
| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| worker, both rounds (issue-worker-max, one resumed agent) | Fable 5.2 | 367k | not priced |
| batch gate on the PR's tree (gate-runner) | Sonnet 5.5 | 71k | ~$0.20 |
| high-tier review | Opus 5.5 | 156k | ~$0.87 |
Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted.
Effort: effort:max (not escalated)
